findings.source: bytes memory name = names[node]; ERC1155Fuse.getData: if (expiry < block.timestamp) { if (fuses & PARENT_CANNOT_CONTROL == PARENT_CANNOT_CONTROL) owner = address(0); fuses = 0; }
findings.issue: A short storage bytes word is shown as 256 * (x >> 8) instead of x with its low byte cleared, the key of the packed _tokens slot is concat(mem[0]) instead of the hash variable (P4), and the fuse bit test is 65536 * uint1(field_176) != 65536 rather than a bit test on the fuses field.
findings.rule: 256 * (x >> 8) = Mask(248, 8, x); a one-element concat(mem[0]) whose word is a known value is that value; k * uint1(y) != k is not bit(y).

notes: Source loops: balanceOfBatch (ERC1155Fuse 98) and safeBatchTransferFrom (172), both while; the third while is the ABI decoding of accounts with address validation. BytesUtils_LEGACY.namehash is recursive and is kept, correctly, as the separate function internal_0x3bc5 ('recursive, a call takes 6 of the 1024 words of the stack'), called from isWrapped(bytes32), upgrade and wrap; checked against namehash/readLabel/_checkBound (faithful, including OffsetOutOfBoundsError 0x8a3c1cfb and the 'Junk at end of name' revert). Storage bytes reads (names[node]) decode the short/long layout with Panic(34) checks twice, as the bytecode does. Constant ETH_NODE is loaded through scratch memory (mem[0] save/restore, P8). Returns and reverts at the free pointer as raw memory (3 returns, 23 reverts).
summary: A clean text: both loops present, recursion handled as a named internal function, few known patterns; immutables print as 0x0 and some packed-field tests stay cryptic.
